capture.zh: 击败酒醉的克莱芬后可再次挑战80级的清醒克莱芬，胜利获得成就「再次击败克莱芬」（精元已在第一战获得）。

strategy_notes.zh: 80级克莱芬速度很快，攻略作者用谱尼战胜。

engine_notes: Rematch reward is an achievement only; reward.monster is null.
HP not published; 5000 estimated from contemporary 80级 SPT bosses (古尔扎迪/米诺斯 ~5000).
skills: species 855 (form 5029) last four at or below Lv80. A 4399 battle screenshot of the Lv80 rematch (2011-07-22) shows 怒火咆哮 and 醉酒燃烧; later recordings of the Flash client show all four.

Immune to stat drops and innate atk+2: Default per user 2026-10-21 (哈莫雷特及以后多数boss都免疫弱化和自带攻击+2); no period source states either (7k7k 2011-07-22: 出招先手，MISS率高，血厚). The modern client's 难度2 list carries idx 1 (免疫能力下降), supporting only.
source_note: 4399: 「这次是80级的克莱芬…速度貌似很不错…最后用谱尼战胜了」.
